title: Episode #21 – Evolving Family Law To Meet Unique LGBTQ+ & Non Traditional Family Needs
metaDesc: Podcast: family lawyer Jodi Argentino on evolving family law for LGBTQ+ and non-traditional families — parentage, adoption, and identity issues.
bodyHtml:
Episode #21 – Evolving Family Law To Meet Unique LGBTQ+ & Non Traditional Family Needs

Welcome to the show Jodi Argentino!

Today’s guest is an active and passionate LGBTQ+ Family Lawyer and advocate hailing from New Jersey. She’s the recipient of the National LGBT Bar Association’s 2015 Best LGBT Attorneys Under 40 Award, has written dozens of publications and spoken at nationwide events on topics related to Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity Issues across the spectrum of family law, [LGBTQ+ Rights to Parent], [Third Party Assisted Reproduction], [Gender Identity Law] and multiple other deeply important LGBTQ+ Law hot topics.
